translated: "How do I spend my time at home? I spend it drawing."
"It all started when an online friend gave me a ridiculous challenge."
"Once I actually tried drawing, I really got into it."
"Even now, I enjoy drawing copies of ProSeka characters."
"My goal for the future is to have one of my outfit designs used in ProSeka."
I've said this many times on Sekaraji, but I have so much respect for people who can draw.
Are you not very good at it?
Well, I'm in this awkward middle ground where I'm not good,
but I'm not laughably bad either.
It's not like you can't draw at all.
No, it's not that I can't draw at all.
But don't you think there are way too many people in the voice acting industry who are good at drawing?
Their skill level is just... it makes you go, "What even is this?"
